description: Ryufin's five answers for one stock: is the business good, is it safe, is the price fair, is it growing, what is the market doing with it. Each answer has a one-word verdict, a plain sentence, the checks it was read from (with values and dates) and, when it moved recently, what it was before.

ticker.description: US ticker symbol, e.g. NVDA or BRK-B
